standard_prerequisites.name: Functors between abelian categories
standard_prerequisites.statement: Exact functors N : A to B and S : B to A between abelian categories, with faithfulness and essential surjectivity.
standard_prerequisites.use: They are the data of the statement (source lines 4233-4243).

standard_prerequisites.name: Quasi-inverse equivalences
standard_prerequisites.statement: Two functors are quasi-inverse when the two composites are isomorphic to the respective identity functors, functorially.

standard_prerequisites.name: The natural isomorphism g and exactness
standard_prerequisites.statement: The given isomorphism g : N S to the identity allows elements to be transported, and exactness of N and S makes the transport compatible with the additive structure.
standard_prerequisites.use: They produce the map of the displayed composite and its independence of the choices (source lines 4248-4257).

core_obligations: Reduce to one functorial isomorphism: show it suffices to construct S(N(A)) isomorphic to A, functorially in A (source lines 4248-4250).
Construct the map: choose B with an isomorphism f : A to S(B) by essential surjectivity and form the composite f-inverse composed with g at S(B) composed with S(N(f)) (source lines 4250-4256).
Check independence and functoriality: verify that the composite does not depend on the chosen B and f and is functorial, giving the desired natural isomorphism (source lines 4256-4258).

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce the claim to a functorial isomorphism S N A to A and choose B with f : A to S(B).
Write down the candidate map through f, g and S N f.
Assert its independence of the choices and its functoriality.

difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-S-N at source lines 4231-4245: for exact functors N : A to B and S : B to A, if there is an isomorphism N S to the identity of B, N is faithful and S is essentially surjective, then S and N are quasi-inverse equivalences. The proof at source lines 4247-4259 reduces to producing a functorial isomorphism S N A to A, chooses an isomorphism f : A to S(B) using essential surjectivity, writes down the candidate composite f^{-1} composed with g at S(B) composed with S N f, and states that it is independent of the choices and functorial in A. The verification of the independence is delegated in one sentence, so the card's content is the construction together with the exactness hypothesis, which is what makes the middle map available.
